name: Magical Fate
source:
What happens when you, a knowledge-hungry sorceress wanting to explore and uncover the secrets of the arcane, end up casting a forbidden spell and get accused of casting black magic?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你是個求知若渴的女術士，一心想要探索奧術，揭開它的秘密。可要是你施展了一道禁咒，還被指控使用黑魔法，接下來會發生什麼？

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
